prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: one small sprite concept of universal bare-bone battlefield remains for a dark fantasy tactics game.
Input image role: STYLE REFERENCE ONLY for the muted ivory/taupe/purple-gray palette, chunky pixels and low three-quarter overhead camera.
Primary request: ONE compact low heap containing visibly DIFFERENT KINDS OF BONES INSIDE THE SAME HEAP. Do not repeat the same cartoon dog-bone shape. All fragments overlap into ONE irregular mound; do not scatter separate objects or separate clusters.
Required bone variety in each pile: one longer thick broken shaft, two much shorter thin splinters, one curved arc fragment, one flat irregular chipped bone shard, one squat knobbly joint piece, and a short blunt angular chunk. Each kind should be visually distinguishable through its silhouette. Seven to nine fragments total. Universal anonymous remains: impossible to tell human versus monster.
Style: very simple authentic low-resolution pixel art, about 48 by 28 logical pixels of visible sprite inside a 64x64 logical canvas, enlarged with hard square pixel blocks. Limited 8-10 flat colors, small deliberate pixel clusters, selective dark outline, top-left light. Crisp hard stepped edges, not smooth rendering, no antialiasing, no gradients, no fine pores or decorative texture.
Composition: low wide grounded heap seen three-quarter overhead, centered, generous transparent margins, all bones lying horizontally, mostly touching/overlapping.
Avoid: skull, head, jaws, teeth, face, eye sockets, complete rib cage, recognizable pelvis, hands/feet, horns, claws, intact skeleton, tall upright plate, flesh, blood, clothing, equipment, floor tile, pedestal, ground, shadows outside the pile, glow, text, labels, watermark. Truly transparent background.
Composition A: a thick diagonal broken shaft is half buried across the back; a flat chip, short angular stump and thin splinter overlap its front; a small curved fragment curls along the left side; a knobbly joint sits low at the right front. One connected squat mound with an uneven ridge.
